title: Fate/strange Fake
synopsis:
A new Holy Grail War is emerging in Snowfield, Nevada, where mages from around the world summon Servants, heroic spirits drawn from myth and history, to fight on their behalf. However, this war seems to differ from previous ones. The organization behind it appears to have used data from the Fuyuki Grail War for their ritual, resulting in strange happenings. 

Unbeknownst to most participants, this budding conflict is actually a fake Grail War. There exists another set of seven true Servants who are summoned to fight in the genuine Holy Grail War. One of these Servants is a powerful Saber-class who saves the life of Ayaka Sajou, his apparent master, after being summoned. 

With hidden agendas and unpredictable forces at play, the line between the fake and true Grail War becomes unclear, turning Snowfield into a dangerous battlefield.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]
synopsis_es:
Una nueva Guerra del Santo Grial está surgiendo en Snowfield, Nevada, donde magos de todo el mundo convocan a Servants, espíritus heroicos extraídos del mito y la historia, para luchar en su nombre. Sin embargo, esta guerra parece diferir de las anteriores. La organización detrás parece haber utilizado datos de la Guerra del Grial de Fuyuki para su ritual, lo que resultó en sucesos extraños. 

Sin que la mayoría de los participantes lo sepan, este conflicto en ciernes es en realidad una falsa Guerra del Grial. Existe otro grupo de siete verdaderos Servants que son convocados para luchar en la genuina Guerra del Santo Grial. Uno de estos Servants es un poderoso clase Saber que salva la vida de Ayaka Sajou, su aparente maestro, después de ser convocado. 

Con agendas ocultas y fuerzas impredecibles en juego, la línea entre la falsa y la verdadera Guerra del Grial se vuelve confusa, lo que convierte a Snowfield en un peligroso campo de batalla.

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]

episodes_data.title: The Heroic Spirit Incident
episodes_data.description: Due to the anomalous battle taking place in the desert between Archer and Lancer, various factions become aware of the commencement of the Holy Grail War. As the situation unfolds into chaos, Faldeus, tirelessly acquiring information and manipulating the press, catches sight of a girl new to Snowfield. This girl is Ayaka Sajyou, who wanders the city aimlessly. A mark resembling a Command Spell is engraved on her body.

episodes_data.title: Ensemble vs Pretense
episodes_data.description: Following the uproar at the opera house, Saber and Ayaka are detained by the Snowfield Police Department. Saber answers the police’s questioning candidly, showing no regard for maintaining the secrecy of the Holy Grail War. As Orlando expresses exasperation in dealing with Saber and the fallout he is causing, Orlando is visited by a certain man—Hansa Cervantes, a priest dispatched by the Holy Church as Overseer in this fake Holy Grail War.

episodes_data.title: A Battle Without Heroes
episodes_data.description: Clan Calatin finds itself in dire straits after interference from Assassin’s Master, Jester Karture. Hansa intervenes, taking up arms not as the Overseer of the Holy Grail War, but as an Executor hunting Dead Apostles. With the Servants dismissed from the stage, the two men clash in a battle fought without Heroic Spirits.

episodes_data.title: The Canon of Demigods
episodes_data.description: The sun has risen, closing the curtains on the night of the battle at the police station. Orlando, busy with caring for the aftermath of the battle, is visited by Francesca. He fails to conceal his frustration towards Francesca’s flippant attitude. Suddenly, a single arrow soars past them, aimed at Gilgamesh and Tiné who are positioned at the Crystal Hill. After intercepting the second arrow fired shortly thereafter, Gilgamesh and Tiné proceed toward the canyon where they discover another Archer waiting for them.

episodes_data.title: Stars' Banquet
episodes_data.description: Shortly before the battle in the canyon, in a mansion situated in a swamp, a lone mercenary attempted to summon a Servant. His codename is Sigma. He holds no desires for this world, nor any intention of leaving anything behind. Chosen by the fake Holy Grail for this empty shell of a man was a Servant so singularly unique that it could never be summoned in a normal Holy Grail War...

episodes_data.title: The Wandering King's Rock 'n' Roll
episodes_data.description: After leaving the detention center, Saber and Ayaka wander through Snowfield in search of allies. Before long, the two entered a forest made home by Lancer, the Servant who recently engaged in a spectacular battle against Archer. Challenged to prove his prowess and determine whether they would make suitable allies, Saber unleashes his Noble Phantasm as Lionheart.
episodes_data.title_es: El rock 'n' roll del rey errante

episodes_data.title: Back from Twilight, the God Is Come
episodes_data.description: Prior to the battle between Saber and Lancer, Halri Vorzak, a girl who harbors deep hatred for the world of magecraft, summons a Servant of her own. However, what answers her call is an utterly uncontrollable and aberrant Heroic Spirit. As its claws tear through her abdomen, her life begins to trickle away until a lone homunculus reaches out to grasp her dying hand.
episodes_data.title_es: De regreso del Crepúsculo, el Dios ha venido

episodes_data.title: Backstage of a Third-Rate Comedy
episodes_data.description: To repair their damaged Noble Phantasms, several members of Clan Calatin are sent to Caster’s magecraft workshop. After the police officer John Wingard lost his right arm in the previous battle, Caster questions whether he is still determined to take part in the Holy Grail War. Meanwhile, Flat and Berserker attempt to infiltrate the police station after sensing an ominous magical energy enveloping the city.
episodes_data.title_es: Entre bastidores de una comedia de tercera categoría

episodes_data.title: The Nightmare Comes with the Dawn of London
episodes_data.description: Clan Calatin has arrived in front of the entrance of the hospital in hopes of executing a rescue mission for Tsubaki. However, before them appears Alcides, along with his giant dog. The police force and Berserker confront Alcides, who is intent on slaying Tsubaki after identifying her as an enemy in this Holy Grail War, and one by one Servants begin to gather, as if drawn in by the chaos. And thus, the Holy Grail War in Snowfield plunges into a vortex of mayhem.
episodes_data.title_es: La pesadilla llega con el amanecer de Londres

episodes_data.title: Gold and Lion
episodes_data.description: True Archer, having defeated Berserker, stands before the police force menacingly, as if embodying despair itself. Meanwhile, Saber, facing off against Archer, races across the battlefield, using his speed and rapid-fire Noble Phantasm to fend off the King of Heroes. Hansa, witnessing Saber`s seemingly relentless barrage of Noble Phantasms, looks over to Ayaka, who is supplying the magical energy that fuels them, and asks her a question.

episodes_data.title: The Pale Knight
episodes_data.description: Though Archer had defeated Saber, the King of Heroes was also forced to fall when his treasury was sealed off by Philia`s intervention. However, before the shifting tides of the battle could be seen through, a massive fog suddenly enveloped the city. The police force, Flat, Hansa, and members of each faction were all helplessly swallowed by the black fog. When Sigma awoke, he found himself in a garden where the girl at the center of the conflict, Tsubaki Kuruoka, was playing with animals.

episodes_data.title: At the End of the Rope
episodes_data.description: Cerberus stands before Saber and Ayaka inside the dreamworld. Though the police were fighting alongside them, the wounds Saber bore from his previous battle has put him in a critical situation. In an attempt to shake off the weakness that dwells within her, Ayaka hurries to be by his side. But before she can reach him, the shadow of "Little Red" appears before her. Faced with the terrifying specter of her past, the symbol of her deepest fears, she says...

episodes_data.title: This Illusion Becomes Reality
episodes_data.description: Francesca and the others descend into a dream realm filled with chaos.
